name: Temporary No Parking Reservations (All)
description:
Temporary No Parking Reservations layer is maintained by Seattle Department of Transportation. Due to the complex definition queries, source aprx required layers with definition queries to be exported as FGDB and then published.

 
Definition Queries applied to the following layers:
  • Temporary No Parking Reservations (Current)
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NULL) AND (TRUNC (END_DATE_TIME ) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) AND TRUNC (START_DATE_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE)))
  • OR
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL) AND (TRUNC (ACTUAL_END_TIME) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) AND TRUNC (START_DATE_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE)))
  • OR
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NULL) AND (TRUNC (END_DATE_TIME) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) AND TRUNC (ACTUAL_START_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE)))
  • OR
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL) AND (TRUNC (ACTUAL_END_TIME) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) AND TRUNC (ACTUAL_START_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE)))
 
  • Temporary No Parking Reservations (Past, Current, and Future)
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NULL) AND (TRUNC (END_DATE_TIME ) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 15 AND TRUNC (START_DATE_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE) + 30))
  • OR
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL) AND (TRUNC (ACTUAL_END_TIME) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 15 AND TRUNC (START_DATE_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE) + 30))
  • OR
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NULL) AND (TRUNC (END_DATE_TIME) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 15 AND TRUNC (ACTUAL_START_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE) + 30))
  • OR
  • ((ACTUAL_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL) AND (TRUNC (ACTUAL_END_TIME) >= TRUNC (SYSDATE) - 15 AND TRUNC (ACTUAL_START_TIME) <= TRUNC (SYSDATE) + 30))
 
Feature Class: V_TEMP_NOPARK_RESERVATIONS
 
Refresh Cycle: Nightly
 
Contact: SDOT Parking team

name: Major Transit Service Area
description:
A polygon feature layer representing ½ mile (2640 feet) distance walksheds from Major Transit Stops. Derived as a View from SDCI Transit Stop Walksheds layer.
 
 
As per Ordinance 127376, “Transit service area, major” means an area within 2,640 feet walking distance of a stop served by a major transit service, as shown on a map adopted by Director's Rule (DR 01-2026). 

“Transit stop, major” means a stop on a major transit service. 
 
“Transit service, major” means the following transit services:  
1. Commuter rail; 
2. Light rail or street car systems; and 
3. Bus rapid transit routes that are in operation or are funded for development and projected for construction within an applicable six-year transit plan under RCW 35.58.2795
 
Resources
Ordinance 127376
Seattle Municipal Code section 23.54.015 Table B
Seattle Municipal Code section 23.44.017
Seattle Municipal Code section 23.84A.038 "T"

name: Seattle Bus Volumes
description:
A line feature layer derived from the Metro Transportation Network (TNET) King County. Each line segment represents a unique link in the King County transportation network. More information about TNET, including field metadata can be found in the King County GIS Catalogue.

This layer is a simplified version of the TNET that is filtered for segments in Seattle where public bus transit service operates. Five fields are joined to the TNET layer representing the number of daily in-service buses that are scheduled to travel on the segment each weekday. 

Joined fields:

  • CHANGE_NUM - Unique integer that identifies service change period. 157 = Fall 2024
  • TRIP_KIND_CD - S = service trip
  • SCHED_DAY_TYPE_CODED_NUM - 0 = weekday
  • DAILY_TRIP_CNT - The number of times per day the given t-link is traversed by buses meeting all criteria in the given row.
  • ROUTES – Bus routes included in the DAILY_TRIP_CNT

This data can be used to view scheduled in-service weekday bus volumes in Seattle by street segment and is reported in SDOT’s Annual Traffic Report. The current published layer represents bus volume data from the Fall 2024 service change (September 2024 – March 2025) and may be out of date with current service levels. Data will be refreshed annually with the update of the Annual Traffic Report. If you need more recent data, please contact King County.

Maintained by Seattle Department of Transportation

Refresh Cycle: Static, manually updated as required

Contact: SDOT Transit and Mobility team
